answer: Voucher slots in the Garden registry: each established identity holds 3 slots, one 10 POA bond per slot, and sponsors one newcomer per slot. If a sponsored account is slashed, its sponsor forfeits 40% of that bond, 4 POA. Minting 30 fake accounts needs 10 sponsors with 300 POA locked, and if all 30 are slashed the sponsors lose 120 POA. Bypass: an attacker who already owns 10 genuine sponsors pays only idle capital. Check rule: anyone counts slots on the Pearl ledger and rejects a 4th sponsorship; the Umber sponsor graph exposes rings.
